quarterly_data.signal: US expansion per the company's 2026 IR deck: Dongjin has invested approximately USD186m (KRW260bn) since 2H22 to build thinner and ultra-high-purity sulfuric acid facilities in Texas. The Texas thinner facility is scheduled to begin commercial production in 2H26 and is expected to supply a Tier-1 foundry customer's local fab (the Korean version: the local fab of a foundry customer that has already secured a large order); the high-purity sulfuric acid plant is a joint venture with Samsung C&T and Martin, which the company says is well positioned to benefit from US supply-chain localization policies. Company 'Why Invest' point: significant growth from 2027 onwards driven by full mass production at the ~$190M (KRW 260B) Texas hub and expanded supply to global foundries; the deck also cites a global capacity expansion roadmap for domestic and overseas (US, Europe) markets.
quarterly_data.figure: Texas thinner + high-purity sulfuric acid hub, ~USD186m (KRW260bn) invested since 2H22; thinner plant commercial production scheduled 2H26 for a Tier-1 foundry customer's US fab

quarterly_data.signal: Product-level revenue breakdown and drivers from the company's 2026 IR deck (1H FY26, consolidated continuing operations, total KRW 674,960M): semiconductor materials - photoresist (KrF, ArF, EUV) KRW 193,106M = 28.61%, wet chemicals (thinner) KRW 200,717M = 29.74%, others (slurry etc.) KRW 56,603M = 8.39%; display materials - organic insulating layer KRW 56,809M = 8.42%, color resist KRW 31,967M = 4.74%, wet chemicals (stripper, etchant) KRW 35,929M = 5.32%, others (display PR) KRW 39,768M = 5.89%; energy materials (cathode CNT conductive additive) KRW 10,226M = 1.52%; foaming agents etc. KRW 49,835M = 7.37%. Q2 2026 drivers stated by the company: revenue up on higher shipments of semiconductor materials (PR and thinner) and FX (average KRW 1,464.66 -> KRW 1,501.93 per USD); operating profit down 11.0% QoQ on raw-material costs driven by rising oil prices and 1H bonus payouts. Including the China subsidiaries held for sale (before discontinued-operations reclassification) Q2 2026 revenue was KRW 442,965M and operating profit KRW 75,048M. Positioning claims: Korea's first commercial-scale production of EUV photoresist (described as a sole-source supplier position in a market historically dominated by Japanese suppliers); global No. 1 in KrF photoresist for 3D NAND, with demand rising with 3D NAND layer counts; No. 1 domestic share in semiconductor thinner, which benefited from the DRAM upcycle despite weaker NAND demand in 2024-2025. Battery materials: development and supply plans for CNT conductive additives and silicon anodes for clients such as Northvolt.
